title: the Greek mythos
audit_comment: THE GREEK MYTHOS - the D&DG walk round eleven, print pp. 63-74. The headline adjudication: the FRACTION FINGERPRINT - the tiny half-height glyphs of the printed "X 1/2 foot" size cells OCR-merge into garbles the earlier rounds misread as X'Y" inch cells; the archive.org 1st-print page pixels (a pure-Python JPEG decode of the BookReader page images, rendered glyph by glyph) settle nine fraction cells - Zeus, Achilles, Aphrodite, Artemis, Bellerophon, Hecate, Hera, Hermes and Hades (the printed 6'1" of the draft was the Hades 6 1/2 fraction, 78 inches) - plus the one true inch cell Odysseus 5'4". The merged-column catch: the extract tsv fold swapped the Ares and Athena class lines and the Atlas and Cerberus alignments; the column-split dumps fixed five merged-column errors (Achilles fighter 15 not Nil among them). The psionic decode: the chocr glyph widths (I 9-11px, II 30, III 47, IV 54, V 36, VI 50) settle all forty class cells, Dionysus and Hades the pixel-verified three-pipe class III. The odd prints flagged as pinned: Ares move 26/24, Hades move 29, Hades CH 24(-9), Bellerophon move 12, and the pixel-verified Coeus charisma minus four.

banner.title: the Greek mythos - the D&DG walk round eleven, print pp. 63-74: forty beings from Zeus the thunderbolt sovereign of Olympus to Tyche the luck goddess, the ten greater gods (Zeus, Aphrodite, Apollo, Ares, Athena, Dionysus, Hades, Hera, Hermes, Poseidon), the eight lesser gods, the six heroes (Achilles, Bellerophon, Jason, Odysseus, Perseus, Theseus), the six greater titans (Atlas, Coeus, Crius, Epimetheus, Kronos, Oceanus), the demigod Heracles, and the nine monsters across seven planes.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (commit cd645b4, pNNN_full.txt + pNNN_tsv.tsv, print = pdf - 1, pages 064-075; the second printing) with the column-split tsv dumps; the collation voice: the archive.org 1st-print derivative (deities-demigods-1st-print) - the chocr char-level word geometry plus the pure-Python JPEG decode of the BookReader page images rendered glyph by glyph. The adjudications: the FRACTION FINGERPRINT (the half-height small-1, the long slash and the low looped 2 of the printed X 1/2 foot cells decode nine sizes as fractions, not X'Y" inches: Zeus 78, Achilles 66, Aphrodite 66, Artemis 66, Bellerophon 66, Hecate 66, Hera 66, Hermes 78, Hades 78 - the Hades 6'1" draft read was the fraction), the Odysseus 5'4" the one true inch cell, the merged-column swaps (Ares/Athena classes, Atlas/Cerberus alignments, Achilles fighter 15), the psionic glyph-width decode (Dionysus and Hades the pixel-verified class III three-pipe), the Coeus charisma minus four, and the flagged odd prints pinned as printed: Ares move 26/24, Hades move 29, Hades CH 24(-9), Bellerophon move 12.

bools.name: grkHadesHelmInvisible
bools.comment: his helm renders him invisible, used only against Olympus enemies

bools.name: grkHadesOneEntrance
bools.comment: the House of Hades has one entrance, guarded by Cerberus

bools.name: grkHecateAnySpell
bools.comment: she uses any magic-user or illusionist spell at will as if 20th level

bools.name: grkHecateNightTwoSpells
bools.comment: from sunset to sunrise she casts two spells per melee round, one by day

bools.name: grkHecateTwinSpheres
bools.comment: her twin spheres of annihilation move by themselves

bools.name: grkHecateHoundRapport
bools.comment: her clerics have a special rapport with hell hounds

bools.name: grkHecateFullMoon
bools.comment: her clerics sacrifice on the night of the full moon

bools.name: grkHecateThreeFaces
bools.comment: her images often have three faces

bools.name: grkHecatoncheireMeteorSwarm
bools.comment: their hurled boulder groups act as a meteor swarm

bools.name: grkHecatoncheireTenFists
bools.comment: up to ten fists strike close opponents, plus 3-30 for huge ones

bools.name: grkHecatoncheireOlympusEnemies
bools.comment: all are bitter enemies of the gods of Olympus

bools.name: grkHephaestusAdamant
bools.comment: he is the only being able to easily work adamant

bools.name: grkHephaestusShieldAnyClass
bools.comment: the +5 reward shield is useable by any class

bools.name: grkHephaestusForgeHelpers
bools.comment: he works with greater cyclopes, fire elementals, efreet and demons

bools.name: grkHephaestusDwarfFriend
bools.comment: he is friend to the dwarves and teaches their smiths

bools.name: grkHephaestusRedDragon
bools.comment: a red dragon guards the tunnel to his mountain

bools.name: grkHeraCurse
bools.comment: a heard prayer about husband problems may curse the offending male, save negates

bools.name: grkHeraSpying
bools.comment: tracking her husband paramours gave her unparalleled spying methods

bools.name: grkHeraClericVengeance
bools.comment: her clerics carry a vengeance drive, planning defeats for years

bools.name: grkHeraVoiceFear
bools.comment: the failed save flees in terror from her screaming, as the fear spell

bools.name: grkHeraclesNemeanSkin
bools.comment: the Nemean lion skin cannot be pierced; thrusts do one point, slashes half

bools.name: grkHeraclesBerserkerRage
bools.comment: past half his hit points he rages and attacks friend and foe alike

bools.name: grkHeraclesBowNeverMiss
bools.comment: his special bow cannot miss

bools.name: grkHeraclesNoMagicUsers
bools.comment: he will have nothing to do with magic-users or clerics

bools.name: grkHermesMaxThieving
bools.comment: he has maximum thieving abilities

bools.name: grkHermesBlinkDog
bools.comment: he moves as a blink dog and is always hasted

bools.name: grkHermesWingedSandals
bools.comment: his winged sandals allow flight

bools.name: grkHermesHelmInvisible
bools.comment: his helm of invisibility is as the ring of the same name

bools.name: grkHermesCaduceus
bools.comment: the white caduceus controls all nonmagical creatures other than man, no save

bools.name: grkHermesMessenger
bools.comment: he is the messenger of the gods to mortals

bools.name: grkHermesArbiter
bools.comment: he acts as arbiter of disputes between the gods

bools.name: grkHermesClericsFit
bools.comment: his clerics must keep physically fit and run long distances

bools.name: grkHermesWhiteRod
bools.comment: they must carry a white rod as their symbol

bools.name: grkJasonGoldenFleece
bools.comment: the golden fleece heals any wound and raises the recently dead

bools.name: grkJasonLeadership
bools.comment: Jason is noted for his leadership ability and strength

bools.name: grkKronosLavaBalls
bools.comment: at battle start he hurls lava balls created out of thin air

bools.name: grkKronosSickleAdamant
bools.comment: his adamant sickle strikes as a +5 weapon

bools.name: grkNikeDivineAwe
bools.comment: she always uses her divine awe power to stun lesser creatures

bools.name: grkNikeRodPower
bools.comment: her rod of power inflicts 5-50 at a touch, no save

bools.name: grkNikeDeviceDestroy
bools.comment: she destroys any device used against her with a touch, save applies

bools.name: grkNikeClericStrict
bools.comment: her clerics may not transgress once - the penalty is total destruction by lightning

bools.name: grkOceanusGreenShimmer
bools.comment: the titan always has a green shimmer around his body

bools.name: grkOceanusHurricane
bools.comment: he raises hurricane winds with a motion of his hand

bools.name: grkOceanusWaterCommand
bools.comment: water creatures of less than divine status must obey him

bools.name: grkOceanusPoseidonOutranks
bools.comment: Poseidon outranks him on the Prime Material

bools.name: grkOdysseusBowOnly
bools.comment: only he can string his powerful bow, gaining his strength bonuses with it

bools.name: grkOdysseusWitOverStrength
bools.comment: he prefers wit and cunning over strength

bools.name: grkOdysseusPoseidonCurse
bools.comment: blinding Polyphemus brought the Poseidon curse and ten years of wandering

bools.name: grkPanTwoAspects
bools.comment: the god of nature is both beneficent and fearsomely destructive

bools.name: grkPanVoiceFear
bools.comment: his voice causes fear as the spell, save applies

bools.name: grkPanSyrinx
bools.comment: his syrinx pipes play as a rod of beguiling

bools.name: grkPanShout
bools.comment: past a quarter of his hit points he shouts 4 rounds of fear with no save

bools.name: grkPanApolloEnemy
bools.comment: he and Apollo are enemies - the rivalry reaches the Prime Material

bools.name: grkPerseusPaladin
bools.comment: Perseus is a 15th level paladin

bools.name: grkPerseusMedusaHead
bools.comment: he took the head of the first and most powerful medusa

bools.name: grkPerseusHadesHelm
bools.comment: Hades loaned him the helm of invisibility

bools.name: grkPerseusHermesSandals
bools.comment: Hermes gave him the winged sandals and a vorpal blade

bools.name: grkPerseusAegis
bools.comment: Athena lent him the bright Aegis shield - all later returned

bools.name: grkPoseidonWaterCommand
bools.comment: he commands any non-divine creature of the water

bools.name: grkPoseidonCreateLife
bools.comment: he creates life in any form, often originating new life forms

bools.name: grkPoseidonCoastAnger
bools.comment: a coastal town that fails the monthly sacrifice risks blood, rubble or flood

bools.name: grkPoseidonHorses
bools.comment: he is responsible for the creation of all horses

bools.name: grkPoseidonPaladinHorse
bools.comment: he rewards high priests with a paladin-quality horse

bools.name: grkPoseidonTridentAbsorb
bools.comment: the trident absorbs one spell per round and returns a like spell

bools.name: grkPoseidonWateryHaze
bools.comment: his watery haze acts like a +5 ring of protection

bools.name: grkPrometheusClayCreation
bools.comment: he creates any mortal creature from clay

bools.name: grkPrometheusFireTheft
bools.comment: he stole fire from the sun for humankind

bools.name: grkPrometheusVulture
bools.comment: his regenerating liver was torn out afresh by a griffon-vulture

bools.name: grkPrometheusIronRing
bools.comment: his clerics wear an iron ring set with a mountain stone chip

bools.name: grkPrometheusSelfReliant
bools.comment: he expects self-reliance, not self-centeredness - trickery serves only the whole human race

bools.name: grkPrometheusKillGriffons
bools.comment: his clerics kill griffons and protect titans from attack

bools.name: grkTheseusPaladin
bools.comment: Theseus is a 13th level paladin

bools.name: grkTheseusMinotaur
bools.comment: he defeated the first and most powerful minotaur

bools.name: grkTheseusKnowWeaknesses
bools.comment: he can be counted on to know the habits and weaknesses of all his enemies

bools.name: grkTycheGoodLuck
bools.comment: her good luck spell makes the recipient always win any single contest

bools.name: grkTycheTouchDrain
bools.comment: her touch drains one-half the attacker total original hit points, no save

bools.name: grkTycheBlueSphere
bools.comment: her blue sphere absorbs one attack per round and reflects the damage back

bools.name: grkTychePoorRelative
bools.comment: the pantheon treats her as a poor relative, so she rarely aids them

tables.name: the combat grid
col_comments: The armor class cells (Hephaestus -5 the best, Circe 10 the worst; the greater cyclops the printed -4 dash garble)
The range ceiling cells (0 = a single printed armor class; all forty read single this round)
The hit point cells (Zeus and Kronos 400 the supreme, down to Circe 51; 0 = the hit-dice rows of the two cyclopes, the egp Flame Snake precedent)
The primary move cells (Hades the flagged 29 odd print; Ares the flagged 26)
The secondary move cells (the printed slash ceilings - Zeus 18/24, the eagle 6/48, Nike 24/36, Tyche 12/36, Atlas 24/30, Ares the flagged 26/24)
The attack count cells (the Hecatoncheire the ten fists, the eagle and Cerberus 3, most gods 2)
The attack alternative cells (the 3/2 slashes of Bellerophon, Demeter, Hera, Pan)
The magic resistance cells (0 = the printed Standard or See below of the eight hero and sorceress rows; the Furies and Tyche the 100 ceiling)

The size cells in inches (the nine pixel-verified X 1/2 foot fractions - Zeus, Achilles, Aphrodite, Artemis, Bellerophon, Hecate, Hera, Hermes, Hades; Odysseus the one true inch cell 5 foot 4; Antaeus the 11-21 growth range floor; the eagle the 50 wingspan)

tables.name: the class grid
col_comments: The cleric level cells (Zeus and Kronos 25 the ceiling, Apollo and Athena 20)
The druid level cells (Artemis, Demeter, Hecate, Hermes, Pan; Apollo and Athena the printed cleric/druid pair)
The lower fighter level cells (the paladin pairs of Perseus 15 and Theseus 13)
The upper fighter level cells (the paladin hi cells; all other fighters single-printed, 0)
The ranger level cells (Ares 20 the flagged print, Artemis 16, Jason 16, Apollo 15, Athena none - the merged-column swap settled by the tsv x-geometry)
The magic-user level cells (99 = the Nike printed See below, the egp Isis precedent)
The illusionist level cells (Hades 25 the ceiling; 99 the Nike See below)
The thief level cells (Hermes 25 the maximum thieving god)
The assassin level cells (Ares 12, Hades 15, Hecate 15)
The monk level cells (Atlas and Ares 10, Hades 15)
The bard level cells (Apollo 23 the ceiling, Dionysus 19, Hermes and Pan 15)

tables.name: the ability grid
col_comments: The strength cells (the five 25s of the titans and Apollo, Poseidon, Pan; Circe the mortal 10; Hecate 12)
The strength to-hit bonuses (0 = no printed bracket: the two monsters, Circe, Hecate)
The strength damage bonuses (Hermes the unusual +10)
The intelligence cells (Hephaestus and Prometheus 25; Heracles the mortal 11)
The wisdom cells (Ares the printed 9 odd, Hera 25)
The dexterity cells (the many 25s; Odysseus 16)
The constitution cells (Hades 25; the printed Coeus 23)
The charisma cells (Coeus the pixel-verified -4 minus, Hephaestus the 9, Heracles 17; Hades the flagged printed 24(-9))
The psionic score cells (0 = every being reads the R849 class table this round; no monster point scores printed)

tables.name: the roster grid
col_comments: The roster ordinal cells (the print order, Zeus through Tyche)
The print page cells (63-74, the folio offset PRINT = PDF - 1)
The alignment cells (0 LG, 1 NG, 2 CG, 3 LN, 4 N, 5 CN, 6 LE, 7 NE, 8 CE - the R852 code scheme)
The rank cells (0 lesser, 1 greater, 2 demigod Heracles, 3 hero, 4 greater titan, 5 monster - Prometheus the printed lesser god)

The psionic class cells (the chocr glyph-width decode: I 9-11px Hecate, Pan, Tyche, Apollo; II 30px Zeus; III 47px Dionysus and Hades - the three pipe bars, the R850 Coyote precedent, pixel-verified; IV Hephaestus, Hermes; V the ten 36px readers; VI the six 50px readers)
The plane cells (0 none, 1 Olympus, 2 Tarterus, 3 Hades, 4 the Nine Hells of Hecate, 5 the Prime Material of Hephaestus and Heracles, 6 the Twin Paradises of Epimetheus)
The fixed-damage flags (1 = the printed numeric damage; 0 = the by-weapon rows of Bellerophon, Jason, Perseus, Theseus and the See-below rows of Hecate, Tyche)
The in-each flags (the printed Nth level in each cells: Zeus, Apollo, Athena, Epimetheus, Hera, Poseidon, Oceanus, Prometheus, Tyche)
The enmity flags (the printed rivalry lines: Ares and Athena the war rivalry, Pan the Apollo enemy, Odysseus under the Poseidon curse)
